content.text: BP ≥180/120, Ø signs of end-organ damage
: should look for the s/sxs suggestive of end-organ damage
•neuro sxs (e.g., seizures, vision changes, AMS), N/V, CP, tearing back pain, dyspnea
MAP should not be lowered >25-30% over the first 2-4hrs
, rapid lowering of BP can be harmful
Clonidine, Captopril, CCB, beta blocker, ACEI/ARB
BP ≥180/120 + acute signs of end-organ damage
– Subsequent treatment over first 1-2h to ↓ SBP to 140-160
– Lower BP ≤185/110 before thrombolytic therapy started
– If thrombolytic therapy not planned, only ↓ BP if >220/120
– Reduces HR & shear stress on aortic wall
